name: Bar Oasis
source: Become the bartender at BAR OASIS in this iPhone/iPod Touch adventure. Make cool cocktails and interact with delightful characters, talk to customers, and have fun in general. All this, while learning what it takes to be a bartender in your own good time.
translation: 在这款iPhone/iPod Touch冒险游戏中，成为BAR OASIS的调酒师。调制清凉鸡尾酒，与有趣的角色互动，和顾客聊天并享受欢乐时光。同时，你还可以按照自己的节奏，了解成为调酒师需要掌握的一切。
